{{Wireless adapter |brand=Intel |model=6235ANHMW |revision=(w/ U.FL connectors) |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |if=Mini PCIe (half) |vendor_id=8086 |device_id=088e |subvendor_id=8086 |subdevice_id=4060 |fcc_id=PD96235ANH,PD96235ANHU |fcc_date=10/11/2011 |ic_id=1000M-6235ANH |chip1_brand=Intel |chip1_model=82549MDE |chip2_brand=Intel |chip2_model=DL82550RDE |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |flags=bluetooth, DFS, |oui=B4:B6:76, C4:85:08, C8:F7:33 |lin_driver=[http://wireless.kernel.org/en/users/Drivers/iwlwifi iwlwifi] |win_driver=[https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/27228/Intel-Wireless-Bluetooth-for-Intel-Centrino-Advanced-N-6235-and-Intel-Centrino-Wireless-N-2230 WLAN Driver], [https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/28912?v=t BT Driver] |accessible_UART=No }} Some of these cards have standard U.FL antenna connectors, however, others (mostly those used in Ultrabooks?) use what [http://superuser.com/questions/539737/what-is-this-wireless-cards-connector instead] [http://hardforum.com/showthread.php?p=1039539993 appear to be] [http://www.wellshow.com/rf-connectors/mini-connector/ipex-mhf4-connector/ MHF4 connectors].
This card is used in... *some unknown '''Samsung''' devices (FCC ID: [https://fcc.io/A3L/6235ANH A3L6235ANH]) ** Samsung Series 7 Chronos (NP'''700Z'''5C-SB1AU) *some unknown '''Winmate''' devices (FCC ID: [https://fcc.io/PX9/6235ANH PX96235ANH] [B4:B6:76 OUI shown], IC ID: 9911A-6235ANH) *some unknown '''Hewlett-Packard''' devices (FCC ID: [https://fcc.io/PD9/6235ANH PD96235ANH] [C8:F7:33 OUI shown], IC ID: 1000M-6235ANH), HP SPS 670292-001 0A or 670292-001 0B *some unknown '''DELL''' devices (FCC ID: [https://fcc.io/PD9/6235ANHU PD96235ANHU] [unknown OUI shown], IC ID: 1000M-6235ANHU), DELL P/N 05K9GJ REV A01, CN-05K9GJ-36214-24K-025E-A01
Regarding [http://forums.lenovo.com/t5/Idea-Windows-based-Tablets-and/yoga-13-wifi-issues/td-p/914595/page/63 this] forum there should also be an '''Lenovo''' version of this card with FRU# 69532436.
